thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Forecasted to Post Q2 2019 Earnings of $2.40 Per Share

author: Lisa Pomrenke
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Forecasted to Post Q2 2019 Earnings of $2.40 Per Share
text:
Posted by Lisa Pomrenke on Feb 2nd, 2019 // No Comments
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Investment analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies reduced their Q2 2019 EPS estimates for shares of Apple in a research report issued to clients and investors on Wednesday, January 30th. Piper Jaffray Companies analyst M. Olson now forecasts that the iPhone maker will earn $2.40 per share for the quarter, down from their prior forecast of $3.04. Piper Jaffray Companies currently has a “Overweight” rating and a $187.00 target price on the stock. Piper Jaffray Companies also issued estimates for Apple’s FY2019 earnings at $11.78 EPS, Q2 2020 earnings at $2.78 EPS and FY2020 earnings at $13.05 EPS. Get Apple alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $4.17 by $0.01. Apple had a return on equity of 51.09% and a net margin of 22.72%. The firm had revenue of $84.31 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $84.07 billion. A number of other equities analysts have also weighed in on AAPL. Vertical Group started coverage on Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. They set a “sell” rating on the stock. Bank of America reiterated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. Citigroup increased their target price on Apple from $230.00 to $265.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, October 8th. UBS Group set a $250.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, October 8th. Finally, JPMorgan Chase & Co. reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $272.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, October 10th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have given a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the stock. Apple currently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $191.66.
AAPL opened at $166.52 on Friday. Apple has a 12-month low of $142.00 and a 12-month high of $233.47. The company has a market capitalization of $812.23 billion, a PE ratio of 13.98, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.61 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87.
Several hedge funds have recently modified their holdings of the business. ETF Managers Group LLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 3,003.3% during the 4th quarter. ETF Managers Group LLC now owns 20,792 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,280,000 after acquiring an additional 20,122 shares in the last quarter. LS Investment Advisors LLC now owns 255,977 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $40,378,000 after acquiring an additional 22,804 shares in the last quarter. Walter & Keenan Financial Consulting Co. MI ADV boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 2.7% during the 4th quarter. Walter & Keenan Financial Consulting Co. MI ADV now owns 41,927 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,614,000 after acquiring an additional 1,115 shares in the last quarter. Taylor Hoffman Wealth Management boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.3% during the 4th quarter. Taylor Hoffman Wealth Management now owns 34,347 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,424,000 after acquiring an additional 426 shares in the last quarter. Finally, IPG Investment Advisors LLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 5.4% during the 4th quarter. IPG Investment Advisors LLC now owns 110,274 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $17,395,000 after acquiring an additional 5,660 shares in the last quarter. 57.02% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the sale, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Company insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
The firm also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be issued a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.75%. The ex-dividend date is Friday, February 8th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is presently 24.52%.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
